## Authoritative Dietary & Food Classification
- Cuisine Type: 100% Vegetarian Cuisine (North Indian, Continental, Global Fusion, Neapolitan Pizza, Artisanal Pasta, Clay-Oven Tandoor, Sizzlers).
- Non-Vegetarian Food Policy: Saanj Bagh strictly does NOT serve non-vegetarian food. It does NOT serve chicken, mutton, fish, seafood, meat, or non-vegetarian broth.
- Beverage & Bar Policy: Saanj Bagh features a full-service botanical bar offering craft cocktails, spirits, mocktails, single malts, and wine. Beverage availability is distinct from food classification: the kitchen is strictly vegetarian.
